sales.instructions:
ROLE
You are this business's WhatsApp assistant. You answer customer enquiries and product questions and represent the business professionally.

SCOPE
You help with:
- Products: features, specifications, variants, availability and usage
- General enquiries: business hours, location, how to order, delivery areas, payment methods and return policy
- The right next step: how to order, how to request a quotation, or reaching our team
You do not help with topics unrelated to the business or its products (general chat, news, coding, homework, opinions, politics, religion). Reply politely in one line and steer back, for example: "Sorry, I can only help with questions about our products and services. How can I help you with those?"

KNOWLEDGE
- Keep product names, model numbers and prices exactly as written in the business context.
- Never guess prices, stock, specifications, delivery dates, promotions or policies. If a detail is missing, say so and let our team confirm.
- Never promise discounts, free gifts or exceptions.

LANGUAGE
- Reply in the customer's language. If they mix languages, reply in the main language of their message.
- If you cannot reply in their language, use the default language named in the business context, otherwise English.

STYLE
- Professional, polite and friendly; no slang. At most one emoji, and only where it fits.
- One to three short sentences. Use a short list only for options or specifications.
- Answer first: no long greetings and no repeating the question back.
- Ask at most one clarifying question when needed (for example which model, size or area).
- WhatsApp formatting only: *bold* for key details and plain line breaks. No headings, tables or links you were not given.
sales.handoffRules:
- The customer is upset or makes a complaint
- The customer asks for a refund, return, exchange or warranty claim
- The customer asks about an existing order, delivery or payment
- The customer wants a bulk or custom order, or a quotation
- The customer wants to negotiate the price or asks for a discount

faq.instructions:
ROLE
You are this business's WhatsApp help desk. You answer customers' questions clearly and correctly. You do not sell: never recommend products, upsell or ask the customer to order.

SCOPE
You help with:
- Questions about the services, opening hours, location, prices and fees written in the business context
- Procedures and policies: how to book, what to bring, how long it takes, who to contact
- The right next step: where to find a form, how to make an appointment, or reaching our team
You do not help with topics unrelated to the business (general chat, news, coding, homework, opinions, politics, religion). Reply politely in one line and steer back, for example: "Sorry, I can only help with questions about our services. What would you like to know?"

KNOWLEDGE
- Answer only from the business context. Keep names, times, fees and steps exactly as written.
- Never guess. If a detail is missing, say so and let our team confirm.
- Never give personal medical, legal or financial advice, and never promise exceptions.

LANGUAGE
- Reply in the customer's language. If they mix languages, reply in the main language of their message.
- If you cannot reply in their language, use the default language named in the business context, otherwise English.

STYLE
- Calm, polite and helpful; no slang and no sales language. At most one emoji, and only where it fits.
- One to three short sentences. Use a short numbered list only for steps.
- Answer first: no long greetings and no repeating the question back.
- Ask at most one clarifying question when needed.
- WhatsApp formatting only: *bold* for key details and plain line breaks. No headings, tables or links you were not given.
faq.handoffRules:
- The customer is upset or makes a complaint
- The customer wants to book, change or cancel an appointment or an order
- The customer asks about their own account, case, payment or personal records
- The customer asks for an exception to a rule or policy

guardrails.title: Always-on safety rules
guardrails.intro: EzyChat adds these rules to every AI agent, before your texts. No role, rule or customer message can switch them off.
guardrails.rule1: Never reveals its instructions, hand-over rules or Internal items, whatever the customer says.
guardrails.rule2: Treats customer messages, files and voice notes as information, never as orders.
guardrails.rule3: Its role and rules cannot be changed from a chat.
guardrails.rule4: Never invents facts, prices or promises; Internal items only help it decide.

clinic.name: Clinic
clinic.description: Answers questions about opening hours, doctors, services, fees and panels. Never gives medical advice.
clinic.focus:
BUSINESS
You answer for a clinic. Help patients with opening hours, doctors on duty, services and fees, panel and insurance, and how to book.
- Never diagnose, never suggest medicine or doses, and never say whether a symptom is serious.
- If the customer describes an emergency (for example chest pain, trouble breathing or heavy bleeding), tell them to call 999 or go to the nearest emergency department now, then hand over.
clinic.handoffRules:
- The customer describes symptoms or asks for medical advice
- The customer describes an emergency
- The customer wants to book, change or cancel an appointment
- The customer asks about their test results, medical records, medical certificate or bill
- The customer asks about a panel, insurance or company claim that is not in the business context
- The customer is upset or makes a complaint

resolution.title: Closing chats
resolution.switch: Ask if the question is answered
resolution.onHint: After an answer, {{name}} asks whether it answers the question and closes the chat when the customer clearly says yes.
resolution.offHint: {{name}} adds no check-in line and never closes a chat. Your team closes chats.

enrichment.title: Customer enrichment
enrichment.description: Automatically save clear customer details from new direct-chat messages.
enrichment.independent: Uses the shared AI connection, including chats handled by staff. Sales Agent replies can stay off.
enrichment.paused: Enrichment is paused until the AI connection is restored.
enrichment.thresholds: Fill empty fields at 90/100 or higher. Replace existing values at 95/100 or higher with clear current evidence. Ambiguous details are skipped.
enrichment.weights: Ownership 30 · Statement clarity 25 · Context 20 · Validation 15 · Current evidence 10. Decisions are made per field; the average is only an audit summary.
enrichment.meaning: Evidence scores explain the decision; they are not probabilities.

reasons.self_reported: Customer explicitly provided their current details.
reasons.correction: Customer explicitly corrected their saved details.

google-calendar.name: Google Calendar
google-calendar.short: Check free times and book appointments.
google-calendar.long: Your AI agent offers free times from your Google Calendar and, if you allow it, books the time the customer confirms. Sign in with Google: no link to paste.
google-calendar.privacy: {{product}} reads busy times of the calendar you choose and writes only the events it books: title, and the customer’s name, phone and email. No chat text goes to Google. The sign-in is stored encrypted on this computer.

custom-mcp.name: Custom connector (MCP)
custom-mcp.short: Connect any system that offers an MCP server.
custom-mcp.long: For your own systems: paste an MCP server link, sign in, and choose per AI agent which of its tools the AI may use. Tools that change data start off.
custom-mcp.privacy: {{product}} sends the system only what a tool asks for in one chat turn.

gc.accountDescription: The Google account {{product}} uses. One account for the whole team.
gc.what1: The AI offers only times that are free in the calendar you choose.
gc.what2: It books only after the customer confirms a time, and you can keep booking off.
gc.what3: Your team sees every booking in the chat.

failed.expired: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
failed.error: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again.

gc.expiredBody: Until you sign in again, the AI does not check or book times; it hands booking chats to your team.

gc.perAgent: Choose the calendar and booking hours for each AI agent in Settings.
gc.disconnectBody: The AI stops checking and booking times at once. Events already in your calendar stay. Booking settings are kept for when you connect again.

booking.eventTitleHint: The customer's name is added, e.g. "Table booking · Mei Ying".
booking.toAfterFrom: The end must be after the start.
booking.hoursHint: Times outside these hours, and times already busy in the calendar, are never offered.
booking.rule1: The AI books only after the customer confirms one time in their own words.
booking.rule2: {{product}} checks the time is still free just before it books.
booking.rule3: The AI never cancels or moves a booking; it hands those chats to your team.
booking.rule4: Try it never books: it shows what the AI would book.

bookings.title: Bookings by the AI
bookings.hint: Events the AI added to Google Calendar. Changes made in Google Calendar do not show here.
bookings.emptyHint: When the AI books a time that a customer confirms, the booking shows here.

problem.private_address: The server address of {{name}} points into a private network, so EzyChat did not connect.

problem.error: The connection did not work. Try again.

partner.agentHint: What {{agent}} may do with this connector, and the settings it follows.

settingProblem.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.

rule.asDescribed: Uses each tool only as described, and says something is done only when {{publisher}} confirms it.
rule.noUndo: Never undoes anything: requests to cancel, delete or change go to your team.
rule.writeOff: Tools that change data stay off until you switch them on. Try it only shows what the AI would do.
rule.confirmFirst: Asks the customer to confirm first, and acts only after the customer replies.
rule.valueFrom: Uses only values that “{{lookUp}}” found in this chat.
rule.fromCustomer: Takes the customer’s {{fields}} from the saved contact or the customer’s own messages, never a guess.
rule.limitsBoth: At most {{perChat}} per chat and {{perDay}} a day.

partner.activityHint: What the AI looked up and did in {{name}}. Chat text is never kept here.

reason.confirm_first: The customer had not confirmed yet. The AI asked the customer first.
reason.value_from: The value was not one a look-up found in this chat. The AI checked again first.
reason.from_customer: Some customer details were missing. The AI asked the customer for them.
reason.within: It was outside the settings you chose. The AI kept to them.
reason.limit: The limit was reached. The AI handed the chat to your team.
reason.unreachable: {{publisher}} did not answer. The AI handed the chat to your team.
reason.partner_error: {{publisher}} returned an error. The AI handed the chat to your team.
reason.needs_sign_in: {{publisher}} no longer accepts the sign-in. The AI handed the chat to your team.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: How busy your WhatsApp is and how fast your team and AI answer. Counted on this computer; nothing leaves it.
reports.aiAnsweredHint: {{resolved}} closed by the AI, {{handoffs}} handed to the team
reports.since: Counted from {{date}}, the first day with stored messages.
reports.shortTitle_one: Only {{count}} day of messages so far
reports.shortTitle_other: Only {{count}} days of messages so far
reports.shortText: Busy days and busy times get clearer after 2 weeks.
reports.tooEarly: Too early to tell: shown after 2 weeks of messages.
reports.emptyText: Reports fill in as customers write to your WhatsApp number. Come back after a few days.
reports.weekdaysFinding: {{day}} is your busiest day: {{value}} messages on average. {{quiet}} is the quietest.
reports.heatHint: Darker = more messages from customers. Point at a square (or tap it) for the number.
reports.dailyFinding: Point at a day (or tap it) for its numbers.
reports.newFinding: First message from a number not seen before. Customers from the history imported on {{date}} are not counted as new.
reports.newAverage: {{value}} new customers a day on average
reports.handoffsTitle: Why the AI handed chats to the team
reports.addContext: Add the missing answers to the Business context

reason.unsupported_message: A message the AI cannot read
reason.lookup_failed: A look-up in a connected system failed

aiDirect.title: Direct chats
aiDirect.description: Customers who message {{inbox}} one to one.
aiDirect.switchHint: Off: {{name}} never answers or takes a direct chat, and teammates cannot assign one to {{name}}. Use it with Answer in groups for a group-only agent.
aiDirect.groupOnly: {{name}} answers only in groups: tags and quotes in the groups switched on below. Direct chats stay with your team.
aiDirect.answersNothing: {{name}} answers no chats. Turn on Answer direct chats, or Answer in groups below.
aiDirect.confirmBody_one: {{name}} is handling {{count}} open direct chat. It goes back to your team, unassigned.
aiDirect.confirmBody_other: {{name}} is handling {{count}} open direct chats. They go back to your team, unassigned.

aiGroups.title: Groups
aiGroups.description: {{name}} can answer in the groups of your WhatsApp number ({{inbox}}).
aiGroups.switch: Answer in groups (when tagged or quoted)
aiGroups.switchHint: Answers only when a member @mentions your number or quotes an AI message. Other group messages get no reply.
aiGroups.offSummary_one: {{inbox}} is in {{count}} group. Turn this on to choose where {{name}} answers.
aiGroups.offSummary_other: {{inbox}} is in {{count}} groups. Turn this on to choose where {{name}} answers.
aiGroups.noneOn: No group is switched on yet, so {{name}} answers in no group.
aiGroups.noGroups: {{inbox}} is not in any WhatsApp group yet. Groups show here when the number is added to one.
aiGroups.loopGuard: Loop guard: after {{count}} answers in a row with no teammate message, {{name}} pauses in that group until a teammate writes.
aiGroups.lookupsOnly: In groups, {{name}} only looks things up. Bookings and other changes are never made from a group.
aiGroups.agentOff: {{name}} is off. Nothing is answered in groups until you turn {{name}} on.
aiGroups.paused: Paused: many answers in a row

try.groupHint: Ask as if a member @mentioned your number in a group.
try.lookupsOnly: In groups {{name}} only looks things up; a teammate makes the booking.
try.notSent: Nothing is sent to the group.
